title: Greatest tour of Alhambra, palaces and Gardens!
text:
This was an outstanding tour. Informative and humorous guide, Jaimie, kept us engaged and the group was great. Very small around 14 people so we all were able to ask questions and talk. We were sharing in the history of Alhambra, Granada and Spain.
Excellent tour!
author: O8828XZlisas

title: Alhambra is a must-see
text: The time of day makes a difference in terms of crowds and weather. Booking well ahead is necessary in order to see the Nazrid Palace part of a tour. It is not always automatically included.Don’t bring small children; it’s too much in terms of walking and the length of tome. They won’t be interested. . The tour could last for 3 to 3.5 hours.
author: Madeline_P

title: Top experience
text: The tour guide was well-informed and could say something about everything. Good time management and impressive buildings, gardens, and views
author: Joern_E

title: Brilliant
text:

title: Wonderful history and views
text: The tour was great!  Our guide Jaime was very knowledgeable about the history and legends of the Alhambra. It made an amazing experience even better.
author: joeykatiepaul

title: Great compact guide
text: We did the tour of the Alhambra with Mrs. Chos. It was an absolutely positive experience. We learned a lot and she carried us away with her passion. Thank you very much!
author: l0nd0n3

title: The highlight of my trip to Granada
text: This tour was absolutely amazing. Cristina made this experience truly enjoyable. She was very knowledgeable and funny. I was touched by how much she cares about these amazing places. I saw her picking up trash from the floor in more than one occasion. The tour was just the right amount of information. We were able to stop and take pictures and also to take a bathroom break when needed. Cristina you are the best!
author: Eduardo_P

title: We had a great guide,...
text: We had a great guide, very enthusiastic and knowledgeable. Our group was relatively small (about 10), which made the experience even more enjoyable. At the end, we stayed a little bit longer onsite and walked around again. Surprisingly it was not as busy (at 1pm) and it was great to walk around at our own pace. :)
author: Timothee_G
